title: EIP-8148: Custom sweep threshold for validators
description: Allow setting custom balance thresholds for sweep withdrawals for validators with compounding withdrawal credentials (`0x02`).
author: Dmitry Gusakov (@dgusakov), Dmitry Chernukhin (@madlabman), Greg Koumoutsos (@gkoumout)
laymanDescription: Validators that let their stake compound only get rewards paid out automatically once their balance passes 2,048 ETH. Below that they must request each withdrawal by hand and wait in a shared queue of unpredictable length. This proposal lets a validator choose its own payout level, above which rewards are swept automatically.
benefits: Ethereum validators can now have configurable 'size'
Makes 0x02 validator withdrawal credentials available for any staker without compromises
Allows for the future MAX_EB changes or removal
tradeoffs: Adds a per-validator mapping to the beacon state
Adds new EL request type and corresponding system contract
